name: The Wildos
review:
The Wildos is the original prison-break game for Thunderkick's bandit trio: 15 lines, sticky multiplier wilds and a bonus game.

Thunderkick rates it High volatility, with a 6,250x cap and a 96.15% RTP.

Sticky multiplier wilds are the heart of the game: once they land in the bonus, they keep boosting wins until the round ends. A lively heist story from Thunderkick's bandit series.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
